service.description: RecurrenceList's bases (design §7 RecurrenceFind): the recurring sales orders of the caller's organizations (or the one named), by state (active, the default; paused; ended; failing: the last run failed; all), customer, agreement and text (the base's id or name), newest first, paged; each with its customer, cadence and zone, dates, next occurrence, last order made, amount, agreement, the last failure, its revision and what the caller may do (edit, pause, resume, end, retry a due occurrence). Refuses a caller who neither keeps nor reads the organization's recurrence (PERMISSION_DENIED), an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and a state not listed (STATE_INVALID).

RecurrenceSettings (design §7): a base's schedule. With orderId, an approved sales order of the caller's scope becomes the source of a new base: a copy with no payments of every line (its charges and discounts with its products), approved, marked OrpRecurringTemplate, never reserved, shipped or billed (the order it came from stays an ordinary order); an order made recurring before Sales is kept as it is. With baseOrderId and recurRevision, a base's schedule is changed. The schedule is monthly on a day (1-28, or L) at an hour, weekly on a day, yearly on a day of a month, or a cron expression (frequency cron), read in recurTimeZone (the user's when empty); between recurFromDate (now when empty for a new base) and recurThruDate; kept under recurAgreementId, an active agreement of the seller with the customer (AGREEMENT_INVALID); recurAutoInvoice Y bills each order made once it is approved, at placement or later by a person (invoice#RecurringOrder), and needs the finance right (RECEIVABLE_EDIT) to turn on. Through mantle.order.OrderServices.update#OrderRecur. Needs SALES_RECURRENCE_MANAGE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses another organization's order or base (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an order not approved (ORDER_NOT_APPROVED), a schedule that cannot be read (SCHEDULE_INVALID), an unknown zone (ZONE_INVALID), an end before the start (DATE_INVALID) and a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED).

RecurrenceAction (design §7) at the base's revision: pause (with a reason; the occurrences that fall in the pause are skipped), resume, end (with a reason, now or at a later date), or retry: the due occurrence ordered now through create#RecurringOrder, one order for an occurrence, so a retry after the job ran answers the order the job made; keyed by operationKey, so a double submit answers the first result; a failure is recorded on the base and returned. Needs SALES_RECURRENCE_MANAGE on a base of the scope; refuses another's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an operation the state does not allow (STATE_INVALID), a retry with nothing due (NOTHING_DUE), a missing reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and a stale revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED).

Subscriptions in Sales' context (design §7, Commerce's Subscriptions mounted with a Sales context): the store contracts of the stores of the caller's organizations, read only (Commerce keeps them), beside the storeless Subscription rows of native orders sold by those organizations, each with its customer, product, period or paid-through, next renewal, billing (a store contract's state; a storeless row's "Billed" or "No billing link") and access apart, the order it came from, its recurring base and the agreement it is kept under; by kind (all, store, storeless), organization, customer, agreement (storeless only) and store (store contracts only), newest first, paged. A Sales reader's (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

Follow up (design §7 Subscriptions): a Commons task (mantle.work.TaskServices.create#SimpleTask) on the customer of a store contract (contractId) or a storeless subscription (subscriptionId) of the caller's scope, assigned to the caller or a person who works for its organization (OWNER_INVALID), due when given, linked to the customer (link#WorkEffortRecord), so it shows in the assignee's Today. Needs SALES_ACCOUNT_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); another organization's subscription answers as missing (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Internal (impl-sales follow-up 2; §4 Nov 14): run by the SalesRecurrenceApprovedInvoice SECA once an order's approval commits, by the job's automatic approval or a person's. An order the worker made for an occurrence of a base whose auto-invoice is on (recurAutoInvoice Y), not a Shop contract's base, has each approved sale part with nothing billed invoiced through Accounting's create#FulfillmentInvoice (the ordered basis, one invoice for a source), each in its own transaction; any other order is left as it is, so it bills once. Reads only the records (no supplied party or flag); a part that cannot be billed is logged naming the order and never fails the approval.
